data.name: Hajurah
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'hajarah', meaning 'pilgrim'. This name signifies a woman who is deeply devoted to her faith and has made the journey to the Holy Land of Mecca to perform the Hajj pilgrimage. in_arabic.name: حجورة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من حرمة و عزّة و مكانة عالية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم حجورة مشتق من الجورة و الحرمة و العزّة و المكانة العالية، و يعني الارتفاع في الشرف و المكانة، و هو اسم ذو أصول عربية أصيلة و يرمز إلى الرفعة و الكرامة.

in_urdu.name: حجورة
in_urdu.meaning: عزت و مقام کی اعلیٰ سطح پر
in_urdu.long_meaning: حجورة نام عربى جڑوں سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب عزت، مقام، اور رفعت کی بلندى سے ہے۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں مقبول ہے اور اسلامی تقليد كے مطابق عزت و كرامت کا مطلب رکھتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: हजूरा
in_hindi.meaning: उच्च सम्मान और गरिमा की स्थिति
in_hindi.long_meaning: हजूरा नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ उच्च सम्मान, गरिमा और प्रतिष्ठा की स्थिति से है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में पारंपरिक और आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है।

in_pashto.name: حجورة
in_pashto.long_meaning: حجورة نوم د عربي ريښو څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې د عزت، لوړ مقام او درنۍ معنی ورکوي. دا نوم د افغان او پښتن مسلمانو په ميراث كې د عزت او كرامت ښکارنده دی.

data.cultural_impact: The name 'Hajurah' signifies a woman who has accomplished one of the greatest achievements in Islamic tradition - to make the pilgrimage to Mecca. This name holds a deep cultural significance as it is a reminder of the rich history and heritage of over a billion Muslims who share this sacred journey every year. Hajurah symbolizes devotion to faith, commitment to one's belief, and the strength to embark on a spiritual journey that requires a great deal of physical and emotional endurance.
data.spiritual_significance: The name 'Hajurah' holds immense spiritual significance as it represents a woman who has dedicated herself to the pursuit of a deeper connection with God. Through the physical act of making the pilgrimage to Mecca, Hajurah embodies the spiritual journey towards self-improvement and growth. The name serves as a reminder of the Muslim's belief in God and the importance of following His commandments and seeking His pleasure above all else. The name 'Hajurah' is a powerful symbol of the transformative power of faith and the search for spiritual fulfillment through the practice of Islamic traditions and rituals.
